source_artifact.content_excerpt: The agent-launcher skill tells callers to run agents --dry-run before every creation command, which reads as a preflight that would catch a bad launch. It does not validate the model, the reasoning effort, or the account: a deliberately nonexistent model and an invalid effort both pass and exit zero. The skill should say exactly what dry-run does and does not check, so callers stop treating it as a model or effort preflight.
